name: Cyclone Kiran
location: Arabian Sea, approaching the Sindh Coastline and Karachi, Pakistan
impact: Landfall expected near Karachi on July 3rd. Approximately 77,743 people exposed in the immediate zone and ~972,501 affected in the wider region. Significant infrastructure exposure including hospitals, schools, airports, and dams.
context: Driven by La Niña conditions causing Sea Surface Temperature (SST) anomalies of 2–4°C in the Arabian Sea. The system formed from a Low-Pressure System on June 27th, intensified rapidly through late June, reached peak intensity as a Category 3 cyclone on July 2nd, and is projected to make landfall near Karachi on July 3rd.

phases.d1_to_d5: June 30th - July 4th (Peak Intensity, Landfall, and Immediate Response)
